target: AArch64 QEMU virt, PCI, graphical terminal with VirtIO keyboard/tablet
command: QEMU_VIRT='-machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -m 1024 -device ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' python3 scripts/check-compat.py --probe-demo-game-collision
checks: Launched the unchanged stock /Demo/Games/Collision.ZC from the graphical terminal.
The expected graphical scene rendered and changed in response to its animation or control input.
Escape exited the demo and restored the graphical terminal.
The terminal evaluated 40+2 as 42 and zstatus reported failed=0.
scope_note: QEMU runtime acceptance only; live UTM and Pi hardware behavior are not implied.
